content.title: About
content.content: Organic brown rice puffed flakes are whole grain brown rice that has been heat‑treated to expand into light, crunchy pieces. The product retains most of the nutrients of whole rice, including fiber, B‑vitamins, and minerals, while having a low glycemic index.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Puffed brown rice is a popular ingredient in gluten‑free cereals and snack bars.
The organic label guarantees no synthetic pesticides or GMOs were used in cultivation.
Brown rice keeps the bran and germ layers, making it more nutritious than white rice.
The flakes dissolve quickly in milk, yogurt, or juice, creating a airy texture.
Production involves extrusion, a rapid expansion process that creates the puffed shape.

items.title: High in fiber
items.content: Fiber supports healthy digestion and promotes a feeling of fullness.

items.title: Contains magnesium and phosphorus
items.content: These minerals are essential for bone health, muscle function, and nerve signaling.

items.title: Low glycemic index
items.content: Helps maintain stable blood sugar levels, beneficial for people with pre‑diabetes.

items.title: Source of B‑vitamins
items.content: B1, B3, and B6 aid in energy metabolism and support nervous system function.

items.title: Antioxidant properties
items.content: Organic brown rice provides phenolic compounds that help combat oxidative stress.

items.title: Rice allergy
items.content: A small percentage of individuals may experience allergic reactions to rice, ranging from skin rashes to severe anaphylaxis.

items.title: Arsenic content
items.content: Like all rice, brown rice can contain trace amounts of arsenic; it is advisable to vary grain sources and avoid excessive consumption.

items.title: Digestive load
items.content: High fiber may cause gas or discomfort in people with sensitive gastrointestinal tracts.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Enjoy the flakes dry as a light snack, mix them into granola, yogurt, smoothies, or use them in baking (bars, cookies). They also work well as a crunchy topping for salads or as a coating for protein bites.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the puffed rice in a sealed container in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. For longer shelf life, store in the refrigerator to prevent the fats from becoming rancid.
